observed_reply_to_next_request_gap_ms_ex.note: Host log timestamp resolution is 1 ms; the configured minimum was 150 ms.

conclusions: On this exact VDensHO1 / 20C2 appliance, F7 Virtual_READ and 6B GFA_READ coexist successfully in one persistent VS1 session under the tested 150-ms pacing.
The seven selected stable Virtual_READ values were byte-identical P300-before, VS1-F7, and P300-after.
Two in-session P80 guards remained 0x20, so the local GFA identity remained confirmed during the mixed traffic.
This removes the main transport-level objection to a single-owner permanent-VS1 splitter architecture.
This bounded test does not yet validate the full production poll list, HA discovery/update freshness, Virtual_WRITE behavior in permanent VS1, long-duration FF rate, or production recovery policy.
runtime_note: P09 returned 0x93 while P06 was 0x00 and P87 was 0x20. No independent flame/state signal was sampled, so this isolated state must not be assigned a burner-phase semantic.

next_gate.description: Guarded stock-splitter permanent-VS1 smoke test using the existing production Virtual_READ poll list before adding GFA polling.
next_gate.rationale: The mixed primitive traffic is validated, but the complete live splitter/HA polling path has not yet been exercised in permanent VS1 on this installation.
production_patch_after_gate: Add structured read_gfa_ext() / gfaread support only.
Use an explicit GFA transport marker in selected diagnostic poll items.
Retain conservative pacing and FF rejection.
